item.title: Kalman Filter Libraries in 2026: filterpy vs pykalman vs TinyEKF vs mherb/kalman
item.description: Every sensor pipeline starts the same way: you plot the raw readings, see noise, and add a Kalman filter. Then you discover the hard part is not the theory — it is that the four mature open-source implementations make completely different trade-offs, and one of them allocates memory with malloc in a control loop while another simply has no floating-point precision option for your microcontroller.
